Contract ProcessSaleService::enterItem(barcode: Integer,quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	precondition:
		self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and
		quantity>0 and
		Item.allInstances()->exists(i: Item|i.Barcode = barcode and
		i.StockNumber>0 and
		quantity<=i.StockNumber)
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		Item.allInstances()->exists(i: Item|i.Barcode = barcode and
		i.StockNumber@pre>0 and
		quantity<=i.StockNumber@pre and
		i.StockNumber = i.StockNumber@pre-quantity and
		SalesLineItem.allInstances()->exists(sl: SalesLineItem|sl.oclIsNew() = true and
		sl.Quantity = quantity and
		sl.Subamount = i.Price*quantity and
		sl.BelongedSale = self.CurrentSale and
		sl.BelongedItem = i and
		self.CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine->includes(sl) and
		self.CurrentSaleLine = sl and
		self.CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine@pre->excludes(sl)))
}
